load_dataset_from_tfrecord: load a TFRecord dataset from a given path and split using the load_dataset function
add_targets_to_dataset: add target and optional history fields to a trajectory dataset using add_targets
split_and_preprocess_trajectories: split trajectories into frames and add training noise using split_and_preprocess
batch_dataset_frames: batch a dataset of frames into windows of a specified size using batch_dataset
parse_tf_example_trajectory: parse a tf.Example proto into structured tensors using the internal _parse function
